AI Friends Kart — Six-character non-commercial demo v1.2.0
Code and original open kart/track/prop assets: AGPL-3.0-only.
Six runtime characters: separate rights/restrictions; see MODEL-NOTICE.txt.

source.zip contains public code, tests, build/modeling scripts, pinned metadata,
documentation, original open GLBs and their original editable Blender sources.
It does not duplicate the six large character .glb.gz runtime archives or include any new character
Blender projects, raw originals, separate textures, previews or work files.

The exact six runtime character paths/sizes/hashes appear in
  docs/runtime-models.json
They are served separately beside the game at assets/drivers/<id>-driver.glb.gz.
A full repository clone includes them. Source-ZIP users can copy those public
files into dist/assets/drivers/ or explicitly run npm run models:fetch, which
only downloads the fixed public paths and verifies their hashes. Without those
files the code still builds; the game reports original-driver fallback slots.

Build: npm ci, npm run build. Dependencies come from npm. Serve the whole dist
folder over HTTP(S). Playing uses no third-party model service or account.
Optional local replacements remain memory-only, never uploaded or persisted.

The owner identifies the character models as Tripo Free/non-commercial outputs.
Exact applicable redistribution terms have not been independently established;
publication is not a claim of full rights clearance or a new model license.
AGPL does not relicense these character models. Read MODEL-NOTICE.txt.

Current public source: https://github.com/JerryZRic/ai-friends-kart-web
Original upstream: https://github.com/JerryZRic/neon-kart/tree/v1.0.0

Keep source.html, source.zip, LICENSE, NOTICE, SOURCE.txt, MODEL-NOTICE.txt and
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt together with the deployed game.
